summary: VS MEDIA Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a debt conversion and share subscription agreement with S T MENG PTE. LTD. The original convertible note of US$3.8 million was replaced by a one-off debt-to-equity conversion at US$74.70 per share, resulting in VS MEDIA holding 41.52% voting rights. Accrued interest may be settled via cash, waiver, or capitalization. The agreement terminates original conversion mechanics. This event is not a typical special situation like acquisition, divestiture, or going-private; it is a private debt restructuring and equity stake increase.
